Good morning, welcome to VoiceoverGuy.co.uk!

Narration Voiceover

I've spent 16+ years in narration. Book a voice with experience and credibility. A voice that can relate to your product.
Whether it's a corporate film, a web explainer video, or a brand documentary, the voice you choose represents your brand. Don’t fall into the trap of allowing any voice to do it at the expense of cost.


Choosing the Narrator

The narrator is a personal character or a non-personal voice that the creator of the story develops to deliver information to the audience, particularly about the plot. When it comes to the image of a company and you’ve spent all that time and effort creating your awesome brand, don’t settle for anything less than the best.
This is a job was to promote water usage and where it comes from.


Trust a voice with Experience.

Book a voice with credibility. A voice that fits well with your product, brand and message.
From Attenborough-style documentary narration to commercial reads and Apple-style narration, don't allow cost to stand in the way of the right choice. I will never take a job unless I'm 100% right for it.
This is a great animation to promote media monitoring company PhoenixPB. They and myself were very happy with the end result.


How Easy?

Let me give you a custom read first. Sure, I can send you regular demo, but a bespoke version gives you a better idea of how my voice fits with your brand.
Once you have the final approved script, a high quality WAV is delivered back to you the same day, (99% of the time) edited and de breathed should you require.
The quote can also include amends or minor pick ups too. Get in touch now and lets get started.
